strategy.description: How it picks among its accounts.

login_command.title: Login command
login_command.description: The command that logs an account in.

named_only.title: Named accounts only
named_only.description: Only a route or Mission that names an account may draw from it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: How the harness reads the credential.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The secret that holds the credential.

dir.title: Directory
dir.description: The directory of the login, for the kinds that use one.

env.title: Environment variable
env.description: The variable the credential is delivered in, when not the kind's own.

max_concurrent.title: Most at once
max_concurrent.description: Runs that may use it at once.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels a route or Operation may ask for.

files.title: Login files
files.description: Files of the login sealed in the Registry.

renew_command.title: Renew command
renew_command.description: The command that renews the login.

key.title: Pool name
key.description: What routes and Agents choose this pool by. It cannot be changed later.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The Authenticator provider ID, from those the gateway reports.

config.title: Provider's configuration
config.description: The provider's configuration, checked against the provider's own schema. Default: none.

authenticators.title: Sign-in providers
authenticators.description: The Authenticator providers for sign-in, in the order they are asked. Each answers only for the credentials it claims: a key provider for a bearer key, the others for a name and a password. Default: none; nobody signs in.

directory.title: Directory provider
directory.description: The Directory provider ID; required when user access is configured. Default: none.

authorizer.title: Custom authorizer
authorizer.description: A custom Authorizer provider ID, in place of the `access` record's role policy; the gateway's chief tier still applies beside it. Default: none.

authorizer_config.title: Custom authorizer's configuration
authorizer_config.description: The custom Authorizer's configuration. Default: none.

accounts.title: Accounts provider
accounts.description: The Accounts provider ID that keeps the accounts people sign in with, for the account routes. Default: the Authenticator when it offers accounts too.

accounts_config.title: Accounts provider's configuration
accounts_config.description: The Accounts provider's configuration. Default: none.

proxy_user_header.title: Reverse proxy's user header
proxy_user_header.description: The sanitized header a trusted reverse proxy sets to the signed-in user. Default: none.

proxy_lookup_by.title: Directory attribute of the proxy's user
proxy_lookup_by.description: The Directory attribute that resolves the reverse proxy's user.

page_authenticator.title: Page viewers' authenticator
page_authenticator.description: The Authenticator provider ID that names the person asking for one of Moneypenny's pages from the request itself: `coqui_access_mtls` on the gateway's own TLS, `coqui_access_proxy` behind a front door. It answers only under the pages' base, never for `/v1`. Default: none; pages know a person by the page cookie alone.

page_authenticator_config.title: Page viewers' authenticator's configuration
page_authenticator_config.description: The page authenticator's configuration. Default: none.

login_tries_per_address.title: Tries a minute per client address
login_tries_per_address.description: Password or key tries a minute from one client address. Default: 5.

login_tries_per_name.title: Tries in ten minutes per account name
login_tries_per_name.description: Tries in ten minutes for one account name, from anywhere. Default: 10.

client_address_header.title: Reverse proxy's client address header
client_address_header.description: The header a trusted proxy sets to the client address. Default: none.

access_cache_ttl.title: Keep a found person or a grant for
access_cache_ttl.description: Seconds a found person or a granted action is kept; 0 keeps none. Default: 5.

access_cache_negative_ttl.title: Keep a miss or a denial for
access_cache_negative_ttl.description: Seconds "no such person" or a denial is kept; 0 keeps none. Default: 1.

access_cache_entries.title: Lookups and decisions kept
access_cache_entries.description: The most lookups, and decisions, kept; 0 keeps none. Default: 10000.

key_ttl.title: Personal API key lifetime
key_ttl.description: Seconds a personal API key lives when its maker names no expiry; 0 makes such keys last until revoked. Default: 7776000 (90 days).

assistant_agent.title: The Agent that is Moneypenny
assistant_agent.description: The roster Agent that is Moneypenny.

route_text_bytes.title: Longest route text filter
route_text_bytes.description: The longest `text` filter an Outer Office route may carry, in bytes: in Moneypenny's links and cards, and in the page a message was sent from. 0 reads as 1. Default: 128.

provider_config_depth.title: Deepest provider configuration
provider_config_depth.description: How deeply nested a provider configuration may be.

board_runs.title: Runs on the Mission board
board_runs.description: Runs the Mission board lists from the Registry's records, the most recently updated ones; a Run still live is always listed.

clients_per_run.title: Browser connections per Run
clients_per_run.description: Simultaneous browser connections to one provider Run.

scrollback_events.title: Frames kept for a late client
scrollback_events.description: Value frames kept per provider Run for a client that joins late.

frame_bytes.title: Largest frame
frame_bytes.description: Bytes of one WebSocket or ingress frame. A Station is told at registration how much terminal output that leaves room for, and splits longer output to fit.

input_frames_per_second.title: Browser input frames a second
input_frames_per_second.description: Browser input frames accepted per connection per second.

input_queue.title: Queue to the Stations
input_queue.description: Capacity of the queue between the gateway and its Stations, at least 1.

fanout.title: Queue per Run viewer
fanout.description: Capacity of each per-Run viewer queue, at least 1.

buffer_budget_bytes.title: All the gateway's buffers
buffer_budget_bytes.description: Bytes the gateway may hold in buffers across every Run and connection; the configuration is refused when its limits could exceed it.

client_slots.title: Browser connection slots
client_slots.description: Browser connections the gateway keeps slots for; the configuration is refused when its Runs times connections per Run could exceed it.

attach_token_ttl.title: An attach token lasts
attach_token_ttl.description: Seconds an attach token lives, more than 0.

write_lease_ttl.title: A terminal write lease lasts
write_lease_ttl.description: Seconds a terminal write lease lives, more than 0.

station_token_min_bytes.title: Shortest Station token
station_token_min_bytes.description: Characters the Station token holds at least; a smaller value is looser.

access_token_ttl.title: A sign-in lasts
access_token_ttl.description: Seconds a sign-in that names no lifetime gets, and each renewal gives from then, more than 0 and within `access_token_max_ttl`; longer is looser.

access_token_max_ttl.title: Longest token a request may ask for
access_token_max_ttl.description: The longest lifetime a request for a token may name, in seconds.

session_idle.title: Idle sign-in ends after
session_idle.description: Seconds a sign-in may go without a renewal before it ends; each renewal, which an open app makes while its person works, moves the deadline on. A token lasts the shorter of this and `access_token_ttl`. `"none"` turns the idle limit off.

session_max.title: Longest renewed sign-in
session_max.description: How long renewing keeps a sign-in going, in seconds from when it was made; the password is not asked again until then. `0` turns renewal off, `"none"` (the default) lets it run on while the person keeps working.

session_cookie.title: Keep a browser's sign-in in a cookie
session_cookie.description: Whether a browser's sign-in also gets an HttpOnly cookie, so a reload signs it back in up to `session_max` after signing in; with `false`, or `session_max` at `0`, a sign-in lives in the app's memory alone.

compartment_audit.title: Between audit records of a compartment read
compartment_audit.description: Seconds between audit records of one person's reads of one resource allowed only by one compartment; the app polls, so `0` writes one for every read.

socket_buffer_bytes.title: Smallest socket write buffer
socket_buffer_bytes.description: Bytes the write buffer of a browser's socket holds at least, whatever `frame_bytes` (it holds twice that when that is more).

controls.title: Controls held
controls.description: Controls held for status reads and replays; past it the oldest closed one goes, or the control is refused.

pending_per_station.title: Open controls per Station
pending_per_station.description: Controls one Station may have open.

ttl.title: An open control waits
ttl.description: Seconds an open control waits for its Station before it expires.

poll_wait.title: A Station's poll waits
poll_wait.description: Seconds a Station's poll waits for a control when it names no wait.

max_poll_wait.title: Longest poll a Station may ask for
max_poll_wait.description: The longest wait a Station's poll may ask for, in seconds.

reason_chars.title: Longest operator reason
reason_chars.description: Characters of an operator's reason; longer text is cut.

controls.title: Operator controls
controls.description: `[controls]`: the operator controls waiting for a Station.

page.title: Items in a page
page.description: Items in a page when the request names no limit, at least 1.

max_page.title: Most items a page may ask for
max_page.description: The most items a page may ask for.

text_chars.title: Longest item text
text_chars.description: Characters of one item's text; longer text is cut.

audit_page.title: Audit records in a page
audit_page.description: Records in a page of the audit log when the request names no limit, at least 1.

max_audit_page.title: Most audit records a page may ask for
max_audit_page.description: The most records a page of the audit log may ask for.

attention_items.title: Attention items listed
attention_items.description: Items the attention summary lists; past it the oldest go, and the summary says so.

attention_history.title: Past conditions the attention summary shows
attention_history.description: How far back, in seconds, the attention summary looks for a condition that has since passed, such as a refused configuration a later revision replaced. `"none"` looks as far as the audit log goes.

name_bytes.title: Longest account name counted
name_bytes.description: Bytes of an account name the tries are counted under; longer names are cut.

forget_every.title: Tries between sweeps of old counters
forget_every.description: Tries between sweeps that forget old counters, at least 1.

address_window.title: One address's tries are counted over
address_window.description: Seconds one client address's tries are counted over.

name_window.title: One account name's tries are counted over
name_window.description: Seconds one account name's tries are counted over.

login.title: Counting sign-in tries
login.description: `[login]`: how password and key tries are told apart and counted.

agent_reason_chars.title: Longest reason for lowering a clearance
agent_reason_chars.description: Characters of the reason that lowers an Agent's clearance.

green_ink_max_grant.title: Longest green ink grant or clearance
green_ink_max_grant.description: The longest a green ink grant or a clearance may last, in seconds.

green_ink_note_chars.title: Longest green ink note
green_ink_note_chars.description: Characters of a green ink note.

green_ink_expired_window.title: Expired green ink listed by default
green_ink_expired_window.description: How far back the list of expired green ink requests reaches when it is not told.

held_reason_chars.title: Longest reason for a held brief's decision
held_reason_chars.description: Characters of the reason for a held brief's decision.

roster_target_bytes.title: Longest roster target line
roster_target_bytes.description: Bytes of a roster record's target line; longer text is cut.

roster_key_bytes.title: Longest roster key
roster_key_bytes.description: Bytes of a roster record's key.

access_name_bytes.title: Longest role, Operation or account name
access_name_bytes.description: Bytes of a role name, an Operation ID or an account name in the access and account routes.

mission_title_chars.title: Longest Mission title
mission_title_chars.description: Characters of the title of a Mission a person starts.

mission_prompt_bytes.title: Longest Mission instructions
mission_prompt_bytes.description: Bytes of the instructions of a Mission a person starts.

max_concurrent_missions.title: Runs at once
max_concurrent_missions.description: Agent Runs it runs at once. Default: 4.

stall_timeout.title: Stall a silent Run after
stall_timeout.description: Seconds without provider or terminal activity before a Run stalls. Default: 300.

loop_timeout.title: Stall a repeating Run after
loop_timeout.description: Seconds without novel terminal output before repeated output stalls a Run. Default: 300.

loop_min_lines.title: Repeated lines before a loop counts
loop_min_lines.description: Repeated terminal lines required before loop detection applies. Default: 50.

blocked_after.title: Mark a Run blocked after
blocked_after.description: Quiet seconds before a prompt-shaped terminal tail marks a Run blocked. Default: 10.

max_runtime.title: Longest a Run runs
max_runtime.description: Longest a Run runs, in seconds. Default: none.

history.title: Lines remembered for loop detection
history.description: Distinct terminal lines kept for repeated-output detection. Default: 4096.

normalize_digits.title: Ignore digits when comparing lines
normalize_digits.description: Whether digit runs are normalized when comparing terminal lines for loops. Default: false.

roles.title: What this Station does
roles.description: `control` (elects Headquarters) and `execution` (runs assigned Missions). Default: both.

terminal.title: Terminal provider
terminal.description: The terminal provider harnesses run in. Default: one that suits the handler.

resources_every.title: Sample a Theater's resources every
resources_every.description: Seconds between samples of each remote Theater's resources; 0 leaves only the requirements probe. Default: 60.

safe_house_caches.title: Rebuildable cache directories
safe_house_caches.description: Directory names the Head of Station may remove from a finished Mission's safe house. Default: `target`, `node_modules` and `.dart_tool`.

safe_house_cache_age.title: Leave a finished safe house alone for
safe_house_cache_age.description: Seconds a finished Mission's safe house is left alone before its caches may go. Default: 604800.

event_queue.title: Events queued per Run
event_queue.description: Events of one Run queued for its event pump; past it the oldest is dropped.

retry_backoff.title: Retry a failed Mission start after
retry_backoff.description: Seconds before a Mission whose start failed is tried again; each further failure in a row doubles the wait, up to `retry_backoff_max`. `0` retries on the next round.

retry_backoff_max.title: Longest wait between start retries
retry_backoff_max.description: Seconds the wait between tries of a Mission start grows to, at most.

check_in.title: Between check-ins with the Registry
check_in.description: Seconds between the Station's check-ins with the Registry.

lease.title: A Mission lease lasts
lease.description: Seconds a lease on a Mission's brief or Run lasts unless the Station renews it at a check-in. A Station whose check-ins can take longer than this loses its Missions to recovery.

intake_attempts.title: Tries to place a brief
intake_attempts.description: Times a brief is placed before it is filed as failed.

role_catalog_bytes.title: Largest role catalog and placement policies
role_catalog_bytes.description: Bytes of the Agent role catalog and of the placement policies a check-in carries; past it, each is left out.

provider_catalog_bytes.title: Largest provider catalog
provider_catalog_bytes.description: Bytes of the provider catalog (each loaded provider with its configuration's schema and form) a check-in carries; past it, the schemas and forms are left out.

found_libraries.title: Most unloaded libraries listed
found_libraries.description: Libraries found on the plugin paths but not loaded that a check-in lists for a person to approve; past it, the rest are left out.

shutdown_wait.title: Wait for each loop when stopping
shutdown_wait.description: Seconds the Station waits for each of its loops when it stops.

request_timeout.title: Longest request to Universal Exports
request_timeout.description: Seconds one request to Universal Exports may take.

queue.title: Events waiting to publish
queue.description: Events waiting for Universal Exports; past it output gives way, oldest first, and a Run's latest state is kept.

terminal_bytes.title: Terminal output in one frame
terminal_bytes.description: Bytes of terminal output in one published frame. Longer output goes as several, and what Universal Exports states at registration lowers it. With room for its header, the default is the gateway's default `frame_bytes`.

pre_bind_terminal_bytes.title: Terminal output kept before a Mission binds
pre_bind_terminal_bytes.description: Bytes of terminal output kept for a Run not yet bound to its Mission; past it the oldest goes.

publish_retry_delay.title: Retry a failed publication after
publish_retry_delay.description: Seconds before a failed publication is tried again; each try doubles it, up to `retry_max_delay`.

retry_max_delay.title: Longest pause between tries
retry_max_delay.description: The longest pause between tries, of a publication or of an input or control poll.

refresh_every.title: Register live Runs again every
refresh_every.description: Seconds between registering every live Run again, which is how a gateway restarted during a quiet spell learns of them.

input_retry_delay.title: Retry a failed input or control poll after
input_retry_delay.description: Seconds before a failed input or control poll is tried again; each try doubles it, up to `retry_max_delay`.

control_wait.title: Control poll held open
control_wait.description: Seconds Universal Exports holds a control poll open; kept under `request_timeout`.

input_wait.title: Input poll held open
input_wait.description: Seconds Universal Exports holds an input poll open; a keystroke ends it at once, so a long wait costs no delay. The gateway's `max_poll_wait` bounds it.

control_queue.title: Mission controls queued
control_queue.description: Mission controls queued for the scheduler.

control_report_attempts.title: Tries to report a control's outcome
control_report_attempts.description: Times the outcome of a control is reported.

poll.title: Between polls of a Source
poll.description: Seconds between polls of a Source whose `interval_secs` is not set.

min_poll.title: Shortest poll of a Source
min_poll.description: The shortest interval a Source is polled at, in seconds; a smaller `interval_secs` is raised to it, and 0 takes the floor away.

report_every.title: Report finished briefs every
report_every.description: Seconds between rounds reporting finished briefs to their Sources.

outbox_every.title: Send the tracker outbox every
outbox_every.description: Seconds between rounds sending the outbox of tracker writes.

reply_every.title: Read new issue comments every
reply_every.description: Seconds between rounds reading new comments on the issues Missions are linked to.

outbox_batch.title: Outbox entries sent per round
outbox_batch.description: Outbox entries sent in one round.

send_attempts.title: Tries to send an outbox entry
send_attempts.description: Sends tried before an outbox entry fails.

retry_backoff.title: Retry a failed send after
retry_backoff.description: Seconds before a failed send is tried again; each attempt doubles it.

replies_read.title: Replies shown of a linked issue
replies_read.description: Stored replies `issue_read` shows of a linked issue, newest first.

reopen_watch_every.title: Read settled items every
reopen_watch_every.description: Seconds between rounds reading the newest settled items again, so a label taken off one is seen and its return reopens it.

reopen_watch.title: Settled items read per round
reopen_watch.description: Settled items read in each of those rounds, per tracker instance, newest first; each is one request to the tracker.

read_wait.title: Wait for a live tracker read
read_wait.description: Seconds one ask for a live tracker read waits at Universal Exports before asking again.

read_bytes.title: Longest live tracker read asked for
read_bytes.description: The most bytes of one live tracker read Universal Exports asks for.

sources.title: Sources and Sleepers
sources.description: `[sources]`: Source polling, Sleepers and the tracker outbox.

reprobe_after.title: Probe a failed Theater again after
reprobe_after.description: Seconds before a Theater the Station could not reach is probed again.

report_every.title: Look a Theater over every
report_every.description: Seconds between looks over a Theater for its requirements and ambient credentials.

transports.title: Looking over Theaters
transports.description: `[transports]`: how often Theaters are looked over.

first_reattach_delay.title: First re-attach try after
first_reattach_delay.description: Seconds before the first try to re-attach to a Run; each failed try doubles it.

max_reattach_delay.title: Longest wait between re-attach tries
max_reattach_delay.description: The longest wait between tries, in seconds.

give_up_tries.title: Tries to give a lease up
give_up_tries.description: Tries at a Registry step a concurrent renewal can refuse, when the Station gives a lease up.

notes_every.title: Write a Run's recent events every
notes_every.description: Seconds between writes of a Run's recent events to its record.

probe_timeout.title: Longest look at a Theater
probe_timeout.description: Seconds the look at whether a Run's Theater still answers may take.

recovery.title: Re-attaching to Runs
recovery.description: `[recovery]`: re-attaching to Runs after a restart.

review_work.title: Other work a review brief lists
review_work.description: Other work a review brief lists for the reviewer.

detail_bytes.title: Longest finding detail
detail_bytes.description: Bytes of a finding's detail, of the lines a review brief quotes, and of a vetting timeline detail.

phrases.title: Manipulation phrases per Operation
phrases.description: Manipulation phrases an Operation may screen for; past it, or past `phrase_bytes`, screened briefs are held.

rate_window.title: Rates are counted over
rate_window.description: Seconds of the rolling window hourly rates are counted over.

proposals.title: Proposals looked at per round
proposals.description: Pending Mission proposals looked at per Operation each round, within `[registry.limits.proposals] results`.

proposal_request_ttl.title: A proposal's green ink request lasts
proposal_request_ttl.description: Seconds the green ink request a class authorisation approves for a proposal lasts.

proposal_settle.title: A proposal waits before it is promoted
proposal_settle.description: Seconds a proposal waits before M promotes it on its own.

expiry_sweep.title: Look at rate holds every
expiry_sweep.description: Seconds between looks at rate holds for expiry.

answer_tail_bytes.title: Review answer searched
answer_tail_bytes.description: Bytes at the end of a review's answer searched for its verdict; the answer ends the message.

goals_bytes.title: Goals a reviewer reads
goals_bytes.description: Bytes of a Mission's brief a reviewer is given.

submitted_bytes.title: Report a reviewer reads
submitted_bytes.description: Bytes of an Agent's plan or final message a reviewer is given.

diff_bytes.title: Change a reviewer reads
diff_bytes.description: Bytes of a Mission's change a reviewer is given; a change cut here says so.

reasons.title: Reasons kept per vote
reasons.description: Reasons kept from one vote, and told to an author sent back.

reason_bytes.title: Longest reason
reason_bytes.description: Bytes of one reason, and of a line a review records.

answer_tail_bytes.title: Reviewer's answer searched
answer_tail_bytes.description: Bytes at the end of a reviewer's answer searched for its vote; the vote ends the message.

write_tries.title: Tries of a contested write
write_tries.description: Times a Station tries a write to a review another Station keeps writing first, before it logs that and leaves it for the next round.

station_window.title: Handlers reported within
station_window.description: How recent a Station's check-in must be for the handlers it reports to count when a panel is filled.

review.title: Reviews
review.description: `[review]`: reviews of Missions' plans and output.

reset_grace.title: Wait past a reported reset
reset_grace.description: Seconds past a reported reset before a Run parked on a limit resumes.

unknown_use_permille.title: Use assumed when none is reported
unknown_use_permille.description: Thousandths used an account whose provider reported nothing counts as, 0 to 1,000.

claim_ttl.title: A claim on an account lasts
claim_ttl.description: Seconds a claim on an account lasts unless the Station renews it at check-in.

limit_horizon.title: Longest a limited account stays out
limit_horizon.description: The longest a limited account is kept out, in seconds, whatever reset time its provider reports.

login_timeout.title: Longest account login
login_timeout.description: Seconds a pool account's login command may take.

models_every.title: Look at the models every
models_every.description: Seconds between this Station's looks at the models each account and route may use; 0 never looks on its own.

model_probes.title: Model listings at once
model_probes.description: Accounts and routes a look at the models asks at once; `null` asks every one at once, and 0 asks none, so a look changes nothing.

model_probe_timeout.title: Longest model listing
model_probe_timeout.description: Seconds a look waits for one account's or route's model listing; one that takes longer keeps the list it had before, or is unknown.

renew_every.title: Between login renewal rounds
renew_every.description: Seconds between the Headquarters Station's rounds over the logins kept in the Registry; 0 runs none.

renew_within.title: Renew a login this long before it ends
renew_within.description: Seconds before a login's known end at which a round renews it: well before its harness's own threshold, so a Run's harness has no reason to.

renew_after.title: Renew a login of unknown end after
renew_after.description: Seconds since a login was last renewed at which a round renews it, where its end cannot be read.

renew_timeout.title: Longest login renewal
renew_timeout.description: Seconds a login's renewal command may take; never past its lease.

renew_lease.title: A login's renewal lease lasts
renew_lease.description: Seconds a Station holds a login's renewal lease; another may take it after that.

renew_backoff.title: First wait after a failed renewal
renew_backoff.description: Seconds before the first retry of a failed renewal; each failure doubles it.

renew_backoff_max.title: Longest wait after a failed renewal
renew_backoff_max.description: The longest wait between retries of a failed renewal, in seconds.

renew_attempts.title: Failed renewals before a person is needed
renew_attempts.description: Failed renewals in a row before an account is marked as needing a person; `null` never marks one.

kind_bytes.title: Longest green ink step kind
kind_bytes.description: Bytes of the kind of a step an Agent asks about.

target_bytes.title: Longest green ink step target
target_bytes.description: Bytes of the target of a step an Agent asks about.

classify_nesting.title: Nesting followed when classifying a command
classify_nesting.description: How deep nested shells (`sh -c "sh -c ..."`) and git aliases are followed when a command is read; the harness gate gets it in `AI6_GREEN_INK_NESTING`.

checked_steps.title: Steps checked at once
checked_steps.description: Steps one `check_approval` call may ask about.

manifest_file_bytes.title: Largest harness configuration file
manifest_file_bytes.description: Bytes of one file of a project's harness configuration.

manifest_bytes.title: Largest overlay manifest
manifest_bytes.description: Bytes of an overlay's `overlay.cfg`, or of one of its `aos` env files.

manifest_depth.title: Deepest overlay manifest
manifest_depth.description: Nesting of a manifest's arrays and tables, its top table being the first level.

files.title: Files in an overlay
files.description: Files and directories in one overlay, the excluded names (`.git`, `node_modules`, ...) not counted.

bytes.title: Largest overlay
bytes.description: Bytes of one overlay's files together.

file_bytes.title: Largest overlay file
file_bytes.description: Bytes of one file of an overlay.

unpinned.title: Issue overlays without a pin
unpinned.description: Issue an overlay whose `[overlay.<name>]` has no pin, reporting it as `unpinned` each time; without this such an overlay is refused. A weakening.

context_bytes.title: Largest overlay context
context_bytes.description: Bytes of the rules, routing and context a Run's overlays add to its initial context together. Past it the Run is refused, naming this setting, rather than its text cut.

fetch_timeout.title: Longest overlay fetch
fetch_timeout.description: Seconds a fetch of one overlay's Git source may take.

deps_timeout.title: Longest dependency install
deps_timeout.description: Seconds installing one overlay's dependency file may take.

output_bytes.title: Largest output of an overlay's step
output_bytes.description: Bytes of each output stream kept from an overlay's setup, env script or package manager.

dotagents_pyz.title: dotagents for overlay commands
dotagents_pyz.description: The `dotagents.pyz` on the Station that runs the `cmds/` of an overlay holding them. An overlay with `cmds/` is refused without it. Default: none.

dotagents_pin.title: Pin of dotagents
dotagents_pin.description: The SHA-256 `dotagents_pyz` must have, `sha256:<hex>`; a mismatch refuses. Without one it is refused unless `unpinned` allows it. Default: none.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: `[overlays]`: reading the overlays loadouts and Operations issue.

probe_timeout.title: Longest requirements probe
probe_timeout.description: Seconds the requirements probe, and a resources sample, may take.

command_timeout.title: Longest provisioning command
command_timeout.description: Seconds one provisioning command may take.

name_bytes.title: Longest required program name
name_bytes.description: Bytes of a required program's name; a longer one fails the probe.

version_chars.title: Longest program version kept
version_chars.description: Characters of a program's version kept from the probe.

lease_ttl.title: A secret's lease lasts
lease_ttl.description: Seconds the leases of a Run's loadout and pool account secrets last.

max_lease_ttl.title: Longest secret lease
max_lease_ttl.description: The longest lease, in seconds; a green ink secret's lease lasts as long as its approval, up to it.

min_matched_bytes.title: Shortest secret looked for
min_matched_bytes.description: Secrets shorter than this are not looked for in what an Agent writes outward: a short one would refuse ordinary words. Smaller is looser.

json_line_bytes.title: Longest line of JSON output
json_line_bytes.description: Bytes of one line of a JSON harness's output held while the rest arrives.

csi_bytes.title: Longest terminal control sequence
csi_bytes.description: Bytes of one terminal control sequence before it is read as text.

gate_timeout.title: Longest harness gate exchange
gate_timeout.description: Seconds the harness gate's exchange with the Station may take; the gate gets it in `AI6_GREEN_INK_TIMEOUT`.

poll.title: Read a detached harness's output every
poll.description: Seconds between reads of a detached harness's output.

script_timeout.title: Longest wrapper script
script_timeout.description: Seconds one of the wrapper's scripts may take over the transport.

name_chars.title: Run name in the wrapper's files
name_chars.description: Characters of the Run's name in the wrapper's file names.

detached.title: Detached harnesses
detached.description: `[detached]`: harnesses run detached over a transport.

pump_poll.title: Check whether to stop after waiting
pump_poll.description: Seconds a runner waits for a harness's next event before it checks whether to stop.

feed_poll.title: Look for spooled events every
feed_poll.description: Seconds between a runner connection's looks for spooled events to send.

replay_batch.title: Spooled events taken at once
replay_batch.description: Spooled events a runner connection takes from the spool at once.

keep_ended.title: Keep an ended Run for
keep_ended.description: Seconds an ended Run is kept by its runner.

cable_request_bytes.title: Largest request through the Cable relay
cable_request_bytes.description: Bytes of one request through a runner's Cable relay.

cable_connect_timeout.title: The Station reaches its Cable endpoint within
cable_connect_timeout.description: Seconds the Station may take to reach its own Cable endpoint for a request a runner relays.

cable_streams.title: Cable relay requests open at once
cable_streams.description: Requests through a runner's Cable relay the Station answers at once for one Run; past it a request is refused until one ends.

read_wait.title: One read of a Run waits
read_wait.description: Seconds one read by the Station of a runner's Run waits for an event.

connect_timeout.title: `ai6 runner connect` reaches the runner within
connect_timeout.description: Seconds `ai6 runner connect` may take to reach the runner's loopback port.

answer_wait.title: A runner answers its authentication within
answer_wait.description: Seconds a runner that accepted `ai6 runner connect` has to answer its authentication.

start_wait.title: A started runner answers within
start_wait.description: Seconds a started runner has to answer.

start_margin.title: Extra time to start over a transport
start_margin.description: Seconds starting a runner over a transport may take past `start_wait`.

start_poll.title: Look at whether a started runner serves every
start_poll.description: Seconds between looks at whether a runner started on this host serves yet.

terminal_poll.title: One read of the connect terminal waits
terminal_poll.description: Seconds one read of `ai6 runner connect`'s terminal waits before it checks whether to stop or give up.

superseded_close_wait.title: Keep a superseded connection open for
superseded_close_wait.description: Seconds a connection another one took a Run from stays open, so the notice saying so is written before the socket closes under it.

retry_pause.title: Shortest pause between tries at a runner
retry_pause.description: Seconds at least between the Station's tries at a runner it cannot reach.

runner.title: Field runners
runner.description: `[runner]`: field runners, the Station's client of them and `ai6 runner serve`.

refused_body_drain_bytes.title: Refused request body read
refused_body_drain_bytes.description: Bytes of a refused request's body the Station's own API reads before it answers.

names_detail_chars.title: Secret names a credential event lists
names_detail_chars.description: Characters of the secret names a credential timeline event lists.

target_bytes.title: Longest refused configuration target
target_bytes.description: Bytes of a refused configuration's audit target.

ephemeral_name_bytes.title: Longest ephemeral Theater name
ephemeral_name_bytes.description: Bytes of an ephemeral Theater's name; a longer one is cut and given a digest.

output_bytes.title: Output `theater_run` returns
output_bytes.description: Bytes of each stream of a command's output `theater_run` returns.

timeout.title: A command may take
timeout.description: Seconds a `theater_run` command may take unless it asks for another.

max_timeout.title: Longest a command may ask for
max_timeout.description: The longest a command may ask for, in seconds.

git_timeout.title: A git command may take
git_timeout.description: Seconds each git command the tools run for green ink may take.

listed_changes.title: Safe house changes in one report
listed_changes.description: Changes of a kept safe house listed in one report.

survey_entries.title: Directory entries one survey walks
survey_entries.description: Directory entries one survey of a safe house walks before it reports a partial size.

reason_bytes.title: Longest reason for a safe house deletion
reason_bytes.description: Bytes of the reason a round gives when it asks to delete a safe house; longer is cut.

audit_target_bytes.title: Longest provisioning audit target
audit_target_bytes.description: Bytes of what a provisioning round's audit record names; longer is cut.

git_timeout.title: Longest git probe
git_timeout.description: Seconds a `git` read of a remote may take before the branch or commit is reported unread.

http_timeout.title: Longest HTTP probe
http_timeout.description: Seconds an HTTP request for an artifact may take.

tracker_timeout.title: Longest tracker probe
tracker_timeout.description: Seconds a read of a tracker item and its comments may take.

file_timeout.title: Longest file probe
file_timeout.description: Seconds a look at a file in a Mission's working directory may take.

comments.title: Comments a probe reads
comments.description: Comments of a tracker item a probe reads, the latest.

partial_line_bytes.title: Longest partial terminal line
partial_line_bytes.description: Bytes of a terminal line the watchdog holds before it counts as a line. Default: 4096.

providers.title: Provider configurations
providers.description: `[providers.<id>]`: provider `<id>`'s Guatiao configuration when the Station builds it with none of its own (handlers, terminals and safe houses).

pin.title: Pinned to
pin.description: The digest its bytes must have, as `sha256:HEX`. A SHA-1 pin is a reported weakening.

publisher.title: Signed by
publisher.description: The key whose signature it must carry, as `ed25519:HEX`; `FILE.sig` beside the library signs its SHA-256. A publisher alone admits anything it signed, a reported weakening.

x-enum-labels.either: Either the pin or the signature
x-enum-labels.both: Both the pin and the signature

require.title: Needs
require.description: Whether the pin and the publisher are each enough, or both are needed.

key.title: Library file
key.description: The library's file name on the plugin path, such as ai6_claude.dll, not a path. It cannot be changed later.

tls_versions.title: TLS versions
tls_versions.description: TLS versions offered and accepted. Default: 1.2 and 1.3.

cipher_suites.title: Cipher suites
cipher_suites.description: An allow-list of cipher suites by IANA name; every suite the profiles give when empty.

kx_groups.title: Key-exchange groups
kx_groups.description: An allow-list of key-exchange groups by name; every group the profiles give when empty.

cipher_profiles.title: Algorithm profiles
cipher_profiles.description: The algorithm profiles allowed. Default: Mozilla intermediate.

pin_digests.title: Pin digests
pin_digests.description: Digests a certificate pin may use. Default: SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512.

check_validity.title: Check validity dates
check_validity.description: Whether a pinned certificate must be inside its validity dates. Default: yes.

allow_chain_when_pinned.title: Allow a chain from a pinned peer
allow_chain_when_pinned.description: Whether a pinned peer may present a chain. Default: no.

allow_resumption.title: Allow run resumption
allow_resumption.description: Whether TLS runs may be resumed, which skips the certificate checks for a peer that held a run. Default: no.

require_ems.title: Require the extended master secret
require_ems.description: Whether a TLS 1.2 connection must use the extended master secret. Default: yes.

total.title: Entries in all
total.description: Entries the whole queue may hold.

rerecord.title: Record the same peer again after
rerecord.description: Seconds before the same peer from the same source is recorded again.

waiting.title: Waiting queue
waiting.description: The bounds of the waiting queue.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The Agent the grant is for; `*` is every Agent.

action.title: May
action.description: What it lets the Agent do.

name.title: Named
name.description: Which one, for an audience that has a name: the Station, Theater, channel, Operation or compartment.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: Explicit grants; nothing is allowed without one.

inbound.title: Inbound handling
inbound.description: What each receiving Agent's relay does with a Cable addressed to it, by Agent; deliver when absent.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: The members of each custom channel.

sender_rate.title: Cables per second from a sender
sender_rate.description: Cables a sender may send each second, over time.

sender_burst.title: Burst from a sender
sender_burst.description: Cables a sender may send at once.

scope_rate.title: Cables per second to an audience
scope_rate.description: Cables an audience may be sent each second, over time.

scope_burst.title: Burst to an audience
scope_burst.description: Cables an audience may be sent at once.

body_bytes.title: Longest body
body_bytes.description: The longest body of a Cable.

max_ttl.title: Longest lifetime
max_ttl.description: The longest lifetime a sender may ask for.

default_ttl.title: Lifetime when none is asked
default_ttl.description: The lifetime of a Cable that asks for none.

x-enum-labels.compartments: A compartment as well as a grant
x-enum-labels.station_grants: A grant alone: a reported weakening

cross_operation.title: Crossing Operations
cross_operation.description: What it takes for a Cable to cross Operations.
